appearances.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Madam President and my colleagues. And to the Majority Leader and Cordell Cleare, thank you for bringing forward the resolution. And I just want to thank Dr. Hazel Dukes for her advocacy on behalf of all people, and especially the children. When I was involved with the Campaign for Fiscal Equity, CFE versus the State of New York, she was there and she supported the process of litigating…

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: Thank you. Thank you, all three, for coming in.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: And that's why I indicated as far as -- I thought I heard you say that the issues and concerns of small businesses have to be taken into consideration. Everyone says small businesses are the backbone of our society. And so I'm not talking about the small businesses, though, I'm talking about the wealthiest New Yorkers.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: I'm sorry, I could not hear you.

recent.title: JOINT LEGISLATIVE HEARING In the Matter of the 2025-2026 EXECUTIVE BUDGET ON TAXES
recent.text: So I was going to say good afternoon. It's almost good afternoon. Thank you for staying the course and making sure that who you represent are being heard here today. Did I hear correctly that all three organizations' representatives agree that we should look at getting resources by taxing the wealthiest New Yorkers -- not the small business people, not the churches and not the analysis…
